headline: Will raise retiree death benefit to $10,000 and approved $372,728.02 in September disbursements.
summary: Approved invoices from McLane Middleton ($6,720) and USI ($10,950). Approved a $3,352.80 monthly benefit for Michael S. Pinkham and a $2,177.20 refund to Robert M. Lueci. Trustees discussed mailing pension statements to DPW employees for about $1,000, and an ordinance addition on repaying missed pension payments after disability leave.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the September 25, 2026 meeting, unanimously.
Approved retirement benefit for Michael S. Pinkham of $3,352.80 per month, pending USI review, unanimously.
Approved return of contributions of $2,177.20 to Robert M. Lueci, as a lump sum less 20% for federal taxes, unanimously.
Will increase the retiree death benefit to $10,000 instead of the proposed $7,000; no vote was recorded.
Approved disbursement of funds for September 1 through September 30, 2026, in the amount of $372,728.02, unanimously.
Approved McLane Middleton invoice of $6,720 for legal fees on the IRS correction project, unanimously.
Approved USI invoice of $10,950 for quarterly pension administration services, unanimously.

Page 1 of 3  
 
  
BOARD OF TRUSTEES 
Division of Public Works Retirement System 
Meeting Minutes 
October 30, 2026 
 
 
A meeting of the Board of Trustees, Public Wo rks Retirement System was held at 10:34 a.m. 
on Friday, October 30, 2026 in The Mine Falls Conference Room located at 848 West Hollis 
Street, Nashua, NH 03062.   
 
 
Trustees Present: 
 
David Fredette, Finance & Investment Professional (Chairman) 
Matt Dube, AFSME Employee Member 
Manny Espitia, BPW Commissioner 
Terri Harris, UAW Employee Member 
Diane Mulholland, Treasurer/Tax Collector, Member 
Michael O’Brien, Aldermanic Liaison (Assistant Chair)  
 
 
Trustees Absent: 
 
Daniel Hudson, Unaffiliated Employee Member  
 
 
Others in Attendance: 
 
 Joanne Boisvert, Trust Accountant 
 Mary Woods, Administrative Assistant 
 
 
Expected Visitors: 
 
None 
 
 
Minutes of the Meeting: 
 
The minutes of the September 25, 2026 meeting were presented for review and acceptance.  
 
MOTION BY:  Alderman Michael O’Brien moved to approve the minutes of the September 
25, 2026 meeting as reviewed and presented. 
SECONDED BY:  Trustee, Diane Mulholland 
MOTION CARRIED: Unanimously by members in attendance 
DISCUSSION:   
 
 
Personnel: 
 
A. MOTION BY: Alderman, Michael O’Brien moved to approve the retirement benefit to 
Michael S. Pinkham who has chosen a 10 Yr. Certain benefit of $3,352.80/mo. pending USI 
review.
Page 2 of 3  
 
SECONDED BY:  Trustee, Matt Dube 
MOTION CARRIED: Unanimously by members in attendance 
DISCUSSION: There was a discussion on beneficiaries after the ten years and what would 
be allotted to that beneficiary.  Ms. Boisvert will reach out to Marc Condon of USI for 
clarification. 
 
B. MOTION BY:  Trustee, Matt Dube moved to approve the return of contributions of $2,177.20 
to Robert M. Lueci who has chosen a Lump Sum option less the 20% for Federal Taxes.  
SECONDED BY:  Trustee, Terri Harris 
MOTION CARRIED: Unanimously by members in attendance 
DISCUSSION:  
 
 
Old Business: 
 
 Trustee Fredette said that the packet that Attorney Rich had received from the IRS regarding 
the ordinance changes has been filled out and sent back to IRS.  Waiting to hear if any 
response has been received. 
 
  
New Business:  
 
A. MOTION BY:   Trustee, Terri Harris moved to approve the disbursement of funds for the 
period of September 1, 2026 through September 30, 2026 in the amount of $372,728.02. 
SECONDED BY:  Alderman, Michael O’Brien 
MOTION CARRIED:  Unanimously by the members in attendance 
DISCUSSION:  Review of the benefit distributions between FY24-FY26. 
 
B. MOTION BY:   Commissioner, Manny Espitia moved to approve the McLane Middleton 
Invoice in the amount of $6,720 for the legal fees and matters regarding Internal Revenue 
Service correction project. 
SECONDED BY:  Trustee, Terri Harris 
MOTION CARRIED:  Unanimously by the members in attendance 
DISCUSSION:   
 
C. MOTION BY:   Alderman, Michael O’Brien moved to approve the USI Invoice for Quarterly 
Pension Administration Services in the amount of $10,950. 
SECONDED BY:  Commissioner, Manny Espitia 
MOTION CARRIED:  Unanimously by the members in attendance 
DISCUSSION:   
 
 
 
Period for Public Comment: 
 
None 
 
 
Items by the Trustees: 
  
Trustee Fredette handed out five examples of the pension statements just to see if anyone 
had any questions. There was a discussion on sending these out via US Mail to all DPW 
Employees.  This would be a cost of approximately $1,000 for the mailing.
Page 3 of 3  
 
 
Attorney Clarke has drafted changes to the ordinance regarding the death benefit allowance 
to retirees increasing it from $3,000 to $7,000.  After a brief discussion we will increase the 
death benefit to $10,000 instead of the proposed $7,000.  There was also a discussion about 
an addition to the ordinance regarding the employee’s responsibility to pay back any missed 
pension payments if they were out on long or short-term disability. This needs to be done 
before they retire in order for them to be eligible for a full pension when they retire. Trustee 
Fredette will have it revised and also look for the revision that was recently made regarding 
an employee who had submitted their retire ment paperwork but passed away a few days 
before the actual date. 
 
Next meeting will be scheduled for Friday, November 20, 2026, at 10:30 a.m.  
 
MOTION TO ADJOURN:  Alderman, Michael O’Brien moved to adjourn at 11:03 a.m. 
SECONDED BY: Commissioner, Manny Espitia 
MOTION CARRIED:  Unanimously by the members in attendance 
DISCUSSION: 
 
Minutes Transcribed by:  Mary Woods
